summary: NIO Inc. announced definitive agreements with Zhejiang Geely Holding Group subsidiaries for a strategic transaction in battery swapping and charging. A Geely subsidiary will subscribe to newly issued equity in NIO Energy Investment (NIO Power), contributing 100% of Yiyi Internet Technology plus RMB640 million cash for a 30.0% stake, valuing NIO Power at approximately RMB16 billion post-money. Concurrently, NIO China will subscribe for 10.0% of Geely's Haohan Energy for cash used to buy NIO charging assets. Geely's NIO Power stake may adjust to no less than 20% on operational underperformance, and it holds an option, exercisable within two years, for an additional RMB640 million, which would raise its stake to 34.0%. The deal is subject to regulatory clearances and customary closing conditions. Key watch items include regulatory approvals and milestone-driven equity adjustments.
